# Generated record and enumeration reference

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_records.py from the Rust sources. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every JLR record is a CBOR map with **integer keys**, encoded as JLR-DCBOR/1 (see
[INTEGRITY_PROTOCOL.md](../INTEGRITY_PROTOCOL.md)). An `Option<T>` field is **omitted** when absent and never
written as `null`; an unknown key, a missing required key, a wrong type, or an encoding that is not the
canonical one is an error. Enumerations are unsigned integers on the wire; their names are for humans.

### `EpnRecord`

The immutable identity of an artifact. Its EPN identifier is derived from the SHA-256 of these canonical bytes, so it can be recomputed by anyone and never changes when local admission state does.  Nothing volatile belongs here. In particular there is no timestamp: when an artifact was first seen is recorded by the ledger's DISCOVER event, because a time in the record would give the same bytes a new identity on every observation.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/artifact.rs`

| Key | Field | Type | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | `schema` | `u32` | Schema version, currently 1. |
| 2 | `class` | `ArtifactClass` | Artifact class. |
| 3 | `name` | `String` | Canonical name, for example a package name or file basename. |
| 4 | `version` | `Option<String>` | Version string when known. |
| 5 | `size` | `u64` | Exact size in bytes. |
| 6 | `digest` | `Digest` | SHA-256 of the exact content. |
| 7 | `provenance` | `ProvenanceRank` | Provenance rank established at discovery. |
| 8 | `signer` | `Option<String>` | Identifier of the signing key or vendor when provenance depends on a signature. |
| 9 | `source` | `Source` | How and where the artifact was found. |
| 10 | `dependencies` | `Vec<Digest>` | Content digests of dependencies that the admission depends on. |

## Enumerations

### `AdmissionState`

Trust state of one artifact.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/state.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `UNKNOWN` | Not yet classified, or evidence is insufficient. |
| 2 | `QUARANTINED` | Present but denied normal execution. |
| 3 | `OBSERVED` | May run only inside a high-restriction observation cell. |
| 4 | `VERIFIED` | Identity and required evidence match policy. |
| 5 | `ADMITTED` | Explicitly permitted for a defined capability set. |
| 6 | `DEGRADED` | Previously admitted, but a measurement no longer matches. |
| 7 | `REVOKED` | Explicitly denied by current policy. |
| 8 | `POLICY_BLOCKED` | Evidence satisfies a prohibition in the active policy. |

### `ArtifactClass`

What kind of governed object an EPN describes.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/artifact.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `BOOT` | Bootloader or boot configuration. |
| 2 | `KERNEL` | Kernel image. |
| 3 | `INITRD` | Initial RAM filesystem. |
| 4 | `MODULE` | Kernel module. |
| 5 | `EXE` | Executable file. |
| 6 | `LIB` | Shared library. |
| 7 | `SCRIPT` | Interpreted script. |
| 8 | `SERVICE` | Service or unit definition. |
| 9 | `CONFIG` | Configuration file. |
| 10 | `PACKAGE` | Software package. |
| 11 | `CONTAINER` | Container or application bundle. |
| 12 | `IMAGE` | Disk or base image. |
| 13 | `POLICY` | JLR policy bundle. |
| 14 | `KEY` | Key material reference. |
| 15 | `FIRMWARE` | Firmware blob. |
| 16 | `DATASET` | Data set. |
| 17 | `RECOVERY` | Recovery artifact. |
| 18 | `OTHER` | Anything else. |

### `Assurance`

How much a report can honestly claim, from the boundary it runs behind.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/state.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `prototype` | Evidence comes only from an emulator or test harness. |
| 2 | `companion` | JLR runs beside the host on the host kernel; host root can subvert it. |
| 3 | `supervisor` | JLR boots first from verified media and governs the host as a workload. |
| 4 | `recovery` | Separately booted rescue environment. |

### `Basis`

On what basis a state was reached. Overrides are never disguised as automatic verification (invariant I-13).

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/event.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `CRYPTOGRAPHIC` | Cryptographic evidence satisfied policy. |
| 2 | `POLICY` | Policy rules were satisfied without a cryptographic anchor. |
| 3 | `MANUAL_OVERRIDE` | A human authorized despite incomplete evidence. |
| 4 | `NONE` | No positive basis; a restrictive or neutral outcome. |

### `CellClass`

Jail class of an execution cell (least to most authority, recovery last).

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/capability.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `CELL-0` | Analysis only: no host home, no network, no devices, tmpfs scratch. |
| 1 | `CELL-1` | Restricted application with scoped persistent storage. |
| 2 | `CELL-2` | Admitted desktop or service workload. |
| 3 | `CELL-3` | Privileged host component. |
| 4 | `CELL-R` | Recovery tooling, valid only in the recovery context. |

### `EvidenceKind`

Normalized kinds of evidence the trust engine understands.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/decision.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `CONTENT_DIGEST_MATCH` | The bytes hash to the digest recorded in the EPN. |
| 2 | `CONTENT_DIGEST_MISMATCH` | The bytes no longer match the recorded digest. |
| 3 | `SIGNATURE_VALID` | A signature verified against a pinned trusted key. |
| 4 | `SIGNATURE_INVALID` | A signature was present but did not verify. |
| 5 | `MANAGED_INSTALLER` | The artifact was written by a signed package transaction. |
| 6 | `PACKAGE_SIGNATURE` | A package or repository signature verified. |
| 7 | `REPRODUCIBLE_MATCH` | A local rebuild reproduced the bytes. |
| 8 | `SETUID_BIT` | The artifact carries the setuid or setgid bit. |
| 9 | `WRITABLE_PATH` | The path is writable by a less-trusted actor. |
| 10 | `STATIC_FINDING` | Static analysis finding. |
| 11 | `OBSERVATION` | Behavior recorded in an observation cell. |
| 12 | `OPERATOR_APPROVAL` | An operator authorized the artifact. |
| 13 | `REVOCATION_HIT` | A revocation entry matched. |
| 14 | `MISSING` | Expected evidence could not be obtained. |
| 15 | `FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR` | Observed behavior that policy forbids. |
| 16 | `PACKAGE_MANIFEST_MATCH` | The installed bytes match the package manager's own file manifest. That manifest is unauthenticated, so this is weaker than a package signature. |
| 17 | `BASELINE_MEMBER` | The artifact is a member of a signed baseline. |

### `NetworkMode`

Network policy attached to a cell.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/capability.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | `NONE` | No network at all. |
| 1 | `LOOPBACK_ONLY` | Loopback inside the cell only. |
| 2 | `DESTINATION_ALLOWLIST` | Only the destinations named by capabilities. |
| 3 | `MEDIATED_PROXY` | Traffic goes through a mediating proxy. |
| 4 | `FULL_USER_NETWORK` | The user's ordinary network. |
| 5 | `PRIVILEGED_NETWORK` | Raw or privileged network access. |

### `Posture`

Trust posture of a scope. `Proven` is always relative to a named scope and never means "free of malware".

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/state.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `DEGRADED` | Boot checks or evidence are pending, missing, stale or contradictory. |
| 2 | `PROVEN` | Required evidence for the named scope is fresh and consistent. |
| 3 | `ISOLATED` | Policy has fenced the scope. |
| 4 | `RECOVERY` | The independent recovery image is active. |

### `ProvenanceRank`

Quality of provenance evidence. A smaller number is stronger.

Source: `crates/jlr-model/src/artifact.rs`

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `REPRODUCED` | Locally rebuilt and reproducibly matched. |
| 2 | `PINNED_VENDOR` | Signature from a pinned trusted vendor key. |
| 3 | `DISTRO_SIGNED` | Signature from an approved distribution repository. |
| 4 | `VERIFIED_CHECKSUM` | Upstream checksum received over a trusted channel. |
| 5 | `SOURCE_KNOWN` | Source is known but nothing authenticates the bytes. |
| 6 | `UNKNOWN` | Nothing is known about where the bytes came from. |

| 8 | `SETUID_EXECUTABLE` | Setuid or setgid executable. |
| 9 | `WRITABLE_LOCATION` | Located in a path writable by a less-trusted actor. |
| 10 | `POLICY_PROHIBITION` | Policy forbids this class or behavior. |
| 11 | `BAD_SIGNATURE` | Signature was present but invalid. |
| 12 | `OPERATOR_AUTHORIZED` | An operator authorization is the basis. |
| 13 | `EVIDENCE_MISSING` | A required piece of evidence is missing. |
| 14 | `DEFAULT_TIER` | Default tier applied because nothing stronger matched. |
| 15 | `SIGNATURE_VERIFIED` | Signature verified. |
| 16 | `OBSERVATION_PENDING` | Observation window has not completed. |

| 18 | `CHECKSUM_VERIFIED` | Verified against an upstream checksum only. |
| 19 | `CELL_CAPPED` | Reduced to a smaller cell than the tier grants. |
